entities.name: tert-Butyl ester substrate
observations: Contains a tert-butyl aryl carboxylate that is converted to the corresponding carboxylic acid.
The heteroaryl core, aryl ether, sulfonamide, stereocenter, and aryl chlorides are retained.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid product
observations: Product is the deprotected carboxylic acid derived from the tert-butyl ester substrate.
No phosphorus is present in the decoded product; apparent phosphorus is a malformed SELFIES-like encoding artifact.

entities.name: Tert-butyl ester deprotection
observations: Transformation is acid-promoted cleavage of Ar-C(=O)-O-C(CH3)3 to Ar-C(=O)-OH.
Reaction class is tert-butyl ester deprotection, not phosphorus incorporation, aryl substitution, or C-C coupling.

entities.name: TFA in chloroform
observations: Direct precedent ord-8115b8d6d43e48d6b62339e025355e89 uses trifluoroacetic acid in chloroform for 5.0 hours and reports 43.3% yield for this substrate-to-acid conversion.
